_what: Food art (plan 13 phase B). Per food: `size` = longest side in the hand, in studs; `throw` = pitch (one hand), heave (two hands: bowls, plates, feasts) or spin (skewers, flat things); `turn` = degrees [x, y, z] that stand the generated mesh the right way up (the generator lays some models down); `land` = the sound it lands with (bowl, plate, soft, sizzle, glass, splash); `accent` = a Signature dish's own landing sound (plan 13 phase C; tools/gen_food_fx.py); `look` = what the model must show (the generator prompt is built from it). Models: Studio generate_mesh -> tools/studio/foods/food_lab.luau (judging row) -> install_foods.luau (templates in ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Foods, raw copies in ServerStorage.StoreAssets.Foods_v2).
